changelog: [When to Segment]: Added two generalized permissive rules — marking candidate boundaries after topic/subject/object/locative-marked noun phrases even before their governing predicate appears, and after short adverbial/temporal/quantity phrases — to increase the pool of defensible fine-grained boundaries so small-T budgets (e.g. T=3) are not starved of candidates (addresses coverage/truncation_shortfall).

[Examples — Segment]: Replaced one redundant -고-connective example with a new example illustrating a boundary after a topic-marked noun phrase preceding its predicate, to demonstrate the new permissive rule without exceeding the 12-example cap.
